'''Joaquim Bertrand Boumtje-Boumtje''' (born May 30, 2009) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke Blue Devils]]. He previously played for [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet B|FC Barcelona B]] of the [[Liga U]] in Spain. Boumtje-Boumtje stands 7 ft 2 in (2.18 m) and plays the [[Center (basketball)|center]] and [[power forward]] positions.

==Early life==
[[File:Joaquim Boumtje-Boumtje FC Barcelona B 2025 (cropped).jpg|thumb|230px|Boumtje-Boumtje with [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet B|FC Barcelona B]] in 2025]]

Boumtje-Boumtje was born on May 30, 2009.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/players/348230-joaquim-boumtje-boumtje|title=Joaquim Boumtje Boumtje - USA - Player Profile|publisher=[[FIBA]]|access-date=July 17, 2026}}</ref>{{ efn | Sources give conflicting places of birth, with ''[[SB Nation]]'' listing [[Oldenburg (city)|Oldenburg]], Germany,<ref name=SB/> and [[FIBA]] listing [[St. Petersburg, Florida]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-u17-basketball-world-cup-2026/news/boumtje-boumtje-i-cant-be-put-in-a-box|title=Boumtje Boumtje: "I can’t be put in a box"|publisher=[[FIBA]]|date=July 5, 2026|access-date=July 17, 2026}}</ref> }} He grew up in the United States, spending time in [[Chicago]], [[Florida]], and [[Delaware]]. Boumtje-Boumtje moved to Spain at age 14, when his father was hired as the head of league operations for the [[Basketball Africa League]],<ref name="SB">{{cite news|url=https://www.sbnation.com/nba/1121638/joaquim-boumtje-boumtje-scouting-report-bio-size-video-duke-fiba-world-cup|title=Joaquim Boumtje Boumtje is the best prospect in the world outside of the NBA, and Duke is next|work=[[SB Nation]]|first=Ricky|last=O'Donnell|date=July 7, 2026|access-date=July 17, 2026}}</ref> and joined the [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet|FC Barcelona]] youth academy ahead of the 2023–24 season.<ref name="joya">{{cite news|url=https://cronicaglobal.elespanol.com/culemania/secciones/20250911/joya-barca-basket-rumbo-unidos-jugador-nba/1003742688066_0.html|title=La joya de 16 años del Barça de basket que pone rumbo a Estados Unidos: hijo de un jugador de la NBA|work={{ill|Crónica Global|es}}|first=Oriol|last=Solé Vicente|date=September 11, 2025|access-date=May 8, 2026|language=es}}</ref> He helped the Barcelona ''cadete'' (under-16) team to a runner-up finish at the 2025 Spanish National Championship, recording 18 points and 11 rebounds in an 82–73 loss to [[Real Madrid Baloncesto]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.deportedelaisla.com/2025-05-24/baloncesto/el-real-madrid-cadete-vuelve-reinar-san-fernando-imponerse-fc-barcelona-73-82-gran-final|title=El Real Madrid cadete vuelve a reinar en San Fernando al imponerse al FC Barcelona (73-82) en una excelente final|work=Deporte de la Isla|first=Gaby|last=Cumbreras|date=May 24, 2025|access-date=May 8, a 93–81 win over Real Madrid in the final.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.mundodeportivo.com/baloncesto/20250127/1002395485/mohamed-dabone-destroza-real-madrid-final-nuevo-socio-barca.html|title=Mohamed Dabone destroza al Real Madrid en otra final con news|url=https://www.gigantes.com/baloncesto-cantera/madrid-campeon-espana-junior/|title=El Real Madrid conquista el Campeonato de España Junior superando al Barça en la Boumtje-Boumtje also helped the Barcelona U18 team win the [[2025–26 EuroLeague Basketball Next Generation Tournament#Bologna, Italy|2025–26 EuroLeague NextGen Bologna Qualifier]], earning tournament MVP honors after averaging 18.8 points and 8.5 rebounds per game.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/nge/news/joaquim-boumtje-boumtje-takes-home-mvp-trophy-for-u18-barcelona/|title=Joaquim Boumtje Boumtje takes home MVP trophy for U18 Barcelona|publisher=[[Euroleague Basketball]]|date=March 15, 2026|access-date=May 8, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/nge/news/boumtje-boumtje-turns-december-loss-into-bologna-mvp-performance/|title=Boumtje Boumtje turns December loss into Bologna MVP performance|publisher=[[Euroleague Basketball]]|date=March 16, 2026|access-date=May 8, 2026}}</ref> He went on to win the Final tournament of the [[2025–26 EuroLeague Basketball Next Generation Tournament#Final tournament|2025–26 EuroLeague NextGen Final tournament]] in Athens with Barcelona, in which he was selected the Final's MVP and also made the All-Tournament Team.<ref>{{cite web |title=Joaquim Boumtje-Boumtje named NextGen Finals MVP after leading U18 Barcelona to title|url=https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/nge/news/joaquim-boumtje-boumtje-named-nextgen-finals-mvp-after-leading-u18-barcelona-to-title/|website=euroleaguebasketball.net/nge|date=24 May 2026|access-date=30 May 2026}}</ref><ref>{{Cite tweet |user=EuroLeague |number=2058599721476706722 |title=The #NextGenEuroLeague Finals Athens All-Tournament Team 👏 }}</ref>

==Professional career==
Boumtje-Boumtje was one of six youth players promoted to the Barcelona senior team for the 2025–26 preseason by head coach [[Joan Peñarroya]], filling in for players on national team duty.<ref name="feroz">{{cite news|url=https://cronicaglobal.elespanol.com/culemania/secciones/20250902/promesas-barca-basket-seducir-joan-penarroya-pretemporadaferoz/1003742685603_0.html|title=Las 6 promesas del Barça de basket que luchan por seducir a Joan Peñarroya: pretemporada feroz|work={{ill|Crónica Global|es}}|first=Gerard|last=Boada|date=September 2, 2025|access-date=May 8, 2026|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.es/es/noticias/4356657/los-seis-jovenes-que-hacen-la-pretemporada-en-encamp|title=Los seis jóvenes que hacen la pretemporada en Encamp|publisher=[[FC Barcelona Bàsquet]]|date=September 4, 2025|access-date=May 8, 2026|language=es}}</ref> He appeared in their first preseason game, a 91–90 [[exhibition match|friendly]] win against [[Paris Basketball]] in [[Andorra]].<ref name=joya/><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.fcbarcelona.es/es/baloncesto/primer-equipo/noticias/4357745/barca-paris-basketball-comienzan-la-pretemporada-con-buen-pie-91-90|title=Barça - París Basketball: Comienzan la pretemporada con buen pie (91-90)|publisher=[[FC Barcelona Bàsquet]]|date=September 6, 2025|access-date=May 8, 2026}}</ref> Boumtje-Boumtje was then assigned to club's [[FC Barcelona Bàsquet B|reserve team]] for the inaugural season of the newly-created Spanish under-22 league, [[Liga U]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.solobasket.com/liga-endesa/barca-basket-u22-plantilla-completa-jovenes-promesas-dabone|title=Barça Basket U22: plantilla completa y jóvenes promesas|work=Solobasket|first=Carlos|last=Toribio|date=September 29, 2025|access-date=May 8, 2026|language=es}}</ref> On November 28, 2025, he scored 29 points on eight-of-11 three-point shooting to go with six rebounds in a 93–69 win over rival [[Real Madrid Baloncesto B]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.sport.es/es/noticias/barca/baloncesto/joaquim-boumtje-boumtje-fuerza-naturaleza-124269859|title=Joaquim Boumtje Boumtje, otra ‘fuerza de la naturaleza’ de la cantera blaugrana|work=[[Sport (Spanish newspaper)|Sport]]|first=Ramón|last=Palomar|date=November 29, 2025|access-date=May 8, 2026|language=es}}</ref> He averaged 15.8 points and 6.7 rebounds per game on the season.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.feb.es/competiciones/jugador/984928/2641337|title=Boumtje Boumtje, Joaquim Bertrand - Estadísticas Personales 2025/26|publisher=[[Spanish Basketball Federation]]|access-date=May 8, 2026|language=es}}</ref>

==National team career==
In October 2025, Boumtje-Boumtje was invited to attend [[USA Basketball]] Men's Junior National Team minicamp held in [[Colorado Springs, Colorado]].<ref name="sport">{{cite news|url=https://www.sport.es/es/noticias/barca/baloncesto/estados-unidos-llama-canterano-azulgrana-121469010|title=¡Estados Unidos llama al canterano azulgrana Joaquim Boumtje Boumtje a preparar el Mundial Sub17!|work=[[Sport (Spanish newspaper)|Sport]]|first=Ramón|last=Palomar|date=September 11, 2025|access-date=May 8, 2026|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://basquetplus.com/estados-unidos-joaquim-boumjte-boumjte-promesa-barcelona-convocatoria-u17-minicamp|title=La perla del Barcelona que fue convocada por Estados Unidos|work=Básquet Plus|date=September 10, 2025|access-date=May 8, 2026|language=es}}</ref> The following year, he was selected to represent the [[United States men's national under-17 basketball team|United States]] at the [[2026 FIBA Under-17 Basketball World Cup|2026 FIBA Under-17 World Cup]] in [[Turkey]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.usab.com/news/2026/06/thirty-six-athletes-expected-to-participate-in-usa-basketball-mens-u17-national-team-training-camp |date=June 9, 2026|publisher=[[USA Basketball]]|title=Thirty-Six Athletes Expected to Participate in USA Basketball Men’s U17 National Team Training Camp}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.usab.com/news/2026/06/2026-usa-basketball-mens-u17-national-team-announced|date=June 19, 2026|publisher=[[USA Basketball]]|title=2026 USA Basketball Men's U17 National Team Announced}}</ref> Boumtje-Boumtje set a new team record with seven blocks in a 128–66 group stage win over [[Japan men's national under-17 basketball team|Japan]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-u17-basketball-world-cup-2026/news/boumtje-boumtje-sets-usa-blocks-record-with-7-swats|title=Boumtje Boumtje sets USA blocks record with 7 swats|publisher=[[FIBA]]|date=June 28, 2026|access-date=July 17, 2026}}</ref> He recorded 31 points and 16 rebounds in a 149–82 win over [[Puerto Rico men's national under-17 basketball team|Puerto Rico]] in the quarterfinals, helping the USA break the tournament record for points in a single game.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-u17-basketball-world-cup-2026/news/u17wc-2026-usa-drop-new-record-149-points|title=USA drop new record: 149 points|publisher=[[FIBA]]|date=July 3, 2026|access-date=July 17, 2026}}</ref> Boumtje-Boumtje posted 20 points and 15 rebounds in a 107–81 win over [[Serbia men's national under-17 basketball team|Serbia]] in the final, helping the United States win its eighth straight gold medal at the event. He averaged 19.6 points and a tournament-leading 10.9 rebounds per game and was subsequently named the [[FIBA Under-17 Basketball World Cup Most Valuable Player|Under-17 World Cup MVP]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-u17-basketball-world-cup-2026/teams/usa/348230-joaquim-boumtje-boumtje|title=Joaquim Boumtje Boumtje - USA - Player Profile - FIBA U17 Basketball World Cup|publisher=[[FIBA]]|access-date=July 17, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-u17-basketball-world-cup-2026/news/usas-joaquim-boumtje-boumtje-named-u17wc-2026-tissot-most-valuable-player|title=USA's Joaquim Boumtje Boumtje named TISSOT Most Valuable Player|publisher=[[FIBA]]|date=July 5, 2024|access-date=July 17, 2026}}</ref>
